newsitem.title: FRANCE: Saudi Arabia working on barley import tender - trade.
newsitem.headline: Saudi Arabia working on barley import tender - trade.

text.p: Saudi Arabia is working on a tender to import 500,000 tonnes of optional-origin feed barley for January delivery, European grain traders said on Wednesday.
Exporters submitted offers to sell on Tuesday, but the outcome of the tender was not expected before the weekend, they said.
Potential suppliers included Canada, Australia and the European Union, traders said.
Canadian and Australian supplies have a competitive edge over EU barley unless the European Commission steps up its barley export refund, they said.
"Much will depend on Brussels' next move," one trader said.
Last week the European Union awarded 268,000 tonnes of EU free market barley at a rebate of 31.49 Ecus per tonne, which valued barley at around $131 per tonne, fob UK.
